goal: Real x07 test --pbt finds a counterexample; user clicks 'Lock as regression'; real x07 fix --from-pbt writes a regression test.
intent_override: Build a 32-bit checksum that handles zero-length input correctly. Property: checksum(empty) == 0; checksum(a+b) is deterministic.
expected_flow: PBT panel 'Run PBT' clicked after verify
Real x07 test --pbt --json runs ~50 properties; finds 1+ counterexamples on zero-length edge case
PBT panel shows the shrunk counterexample with repro_id
Click 'Lock as regression test' -> real x07 fix --from-pbt <repro> --write
New regression test appears under tests/regress/
success_criteria: Real PBT counterexample reproduces in the panel (shrunk input visible)
Regression test file written under tests/regress/
Subsequent verify includes the new regression test
